# Rnd

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Randomization](Language-Features-Randomization)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Rnd:Float32 from:Float32, to:Float32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | In | Float32 | required | Lowest result, or the limit when `to` is left out. |
| `to` | In | Float32 | `0` | The limit, never reached. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** A random float in the range.

## Description

Returns a random float from `from` up to, but not including, `to`. With one argument the range is 0 up to that number.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
SeedRnd 7
r# = Rnd(5, 6)
Print r >= 5 And r < 6
```

```text
1
```
